title: Admitted Series Is Not A Causal Outcome
summary: A map separating admitted observations, longitudinal panels, descriptive direction, outcome claims, attribution, counterfactual evidence, comparison, and ranking.
map_question: What decisions remain between an admitted compatible series and a bounded outcome, comparison, attribution, or causal claim?
interpretation_boundary: Series admission, panel construction, direction and magnitude, outcome interpretation, attribution, counterfactual design, comparison, scoring, and ranking are separate decisions. None is automatic.

nodes.label: Admitted compatible series
nodes.note: A human admission decision accepts bounded continuity; no series is currently admitted.

nodes.label: Longitudinal panel
nodes.note: Periods, points, revisions, breaks, missingness, and uncertainty remain visible.

nodes.label: Direction and magnitude
nodes.note: A declared calculation may support bounded descriptive language.

nodes.label: Bounded outcome claim
nodes.note: Ten inference gates and dual control precede publication.

nodes.label: Attribution
nodes.note: Actor, intervention, receiving authority, alternatives, and transfer limits are explicit.

nodes.label: Counterfactual or causal design
nodes.note: Continuity alone cannot supply the missing counterfactual.

nodes.label: Approved bounded comparison
nodes.note: A common measure, denominator, period, method, lifecycle, and uncertainty contract is required.

nodes.label: Composite score or rank
nodes.note: No scoring or ranking method is authorized.

links.note: All thirty-two panel shells are empty.
No period axis, value, direction, or magnitude exists.
Descriptive change is not automatically an outcome claim.
Outcome language does not transfer attribution.
A causal claim needs an explicit counterfactual design.
No common admitted series contract exists.
A bounded comparison does not authorize scoring or ranking.

what_this_map_supports: Separate public contracts for panel construction, outcome inference, attribution, comparison, and causal evidence.
Visible missing periods, adverse evidence, revisions, breaks, alternatives, uncertainty, and human decision receipts.
An explicit embargo on automatic comparison, scoring, ranking, and cross-entity transfer.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish that an admitted series, value, direction, magnitude, trend, or outcome exists.
It does not establish attribution, a counterfactual, causation, forecast performance, or policy effect.
It does not create a comparison, composite, score, league table, or rank.
next_records_needed: A real Phase 70 series-admission decision and receipt with complete observation lineage.
A populated panel retaining periods, missingness, adverse evidence, revisions, breaks, and uncertainty.
A dual-reviewed claim or comparison packet satisfying every applicable Phase 71 gate.
